out.title: Q2 FY27 business update: advances up 15.3%, deposits up 18.8%
out.summary: Quarterly business update: average advances ₹31,872bn (+14.0% YoY), period-end deposits ₹33,275bn (+18.8%); mobilised USD 11.5bn FCNR(B) deposits under RBI swap facility.
out.key_figure: ₹33,075 billion period-end advances under management as of September 30, 2026 (+15.3% YoY)
